input: Draft a complaint letter to the airline about delays

gold.taskTitle: Draft airline complaint letter about flight delays
gold.taskDescription: Write a formal complaint letter to an airline addressing a flight delay experience.

questions.title: Which airline are you writing this complaint to?
questions.description: Identify the specific airline the complaint letter is addressed to.

questions.title: What was the flight number and travel date?
questions.description: Capture the specific flight number and the date the delay occurred.

questions.title: How long was the total delay in hours?
questions.description: Determine the exact or approximate length of the delay experienced.

questions.title: What reason did the airline give for the delay?
questions.description: Understand what explanation, if any, was provided by the airline at the time.

questions.title: What losses or inconveniences did the delay cause you?
questions.description: Identify specific impacts such as missed connections, hotel costs, lost wages, or personal hardship.

questions.title: What outcome or compensation are you specifically requesting?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a refund, voucher, miles, a formal apology, or another resolution.

questions.title: Have you already contacted the airline about this issue?
questions.description: Determine if there is a prior complaint history or reference number that should be cited in the letter.
